prompt:
Create one exact 2×2 pixel-art horizontal gaze atlas from the supplied reference. Canvas aspect ratio must be 128:70, with four equal complete 64×35 upper-face crops and no gutters, borders, labels, or extra panel. Cell order: top-left LEFT OPEN; top-right RIGHT OPEN; bottom-left LEFT HALF; bottom-right RIGHT HALF.

Use this exact NPC075 angry source. Preserve its newly selected angry brow shape, brow positions, identity, hair/fringe, forehead, nose bridge, eye spacing, narrow eye apertures, muted warm palette, compact stepped amber-brown iris clusters, dark pupils, and subdued glints. Do not redesign brows, lids, face, or pixel clusters. Keep brows locked through native row 24.

Only gaze direction changes between LEFT and RIGHT. Both iris and pupil clusters must move together by about one native pixel in the SAME canvas direction in each open pair. In LEFT, move BOTH eyes' colored iris/dark-pupil centers toward the IMAGE LEFT edge. In RIGHT, move BOTH centers toward the IMAGE RIGHT edge. Move both visibly; do not leave either centered, reverse one eye, or make the pupils converge toward each other. Keep each compact cluster inside its own narrow aperture and preserve source-like alignment. Keep the same left/right pupil x-positions in the matching HALF cell as in its OPEN cell.

The bottom pair uses the exact selected HALF-eye anatomy. Close only the upper lids downward over the irises. Keep both iris/pupil clusters horizontally aligned with their matching OPEN gaze; do not shift either pupil sideways in HALF. Preserve the lower lid at native row 28 and cheek from row 29 onward. Do not widen the aperture or move the lower lid. Keep sclera shaded in the existing source palette; no broad cream/white bands, bright glints, enlarged pupils, or round/vector irises.

Preserve all source pixels outside the eye masks, including hair, forehead, bridge and face framing. Output only the 128×70 atlas, with clean nearest-neighbor pixel-art edges and no smoothing.
